name: Swiss
description_short: The swiss army knife of GameCube homebrew
description_long: Swiss is an all-in-one homebrew utility for the Nintendo GameCube. It allows browsing and loading DOL executables and GCM disc images from various storage devices including SD Gecko, SD2SP2, GC Loader, IDE-EXI, M.2 Loader, USB Gecko, Broadband Adapter (via SMB/FTP/FSP), DVD-R, memory cards, and many more. It also provides hardware emulation for the DVD Interface, Broadband Adapter, and Processor Interface.
